title: Headless Cold, Cold Heart (vNiptonVulpes): Vulpes Inculta's lesson at Nipton (10) to the word brought to Sergeant Kilborn at the Mojave Outpost (100, complete)

actions.text: Path: walking into the Nipton town hall trigger (vNiptonVulpesScript) enables Vulpes; his greeting (0x0013AC1B, end script) sets 10 (spread word of the Legion's deed); at the Mojave Outpost Sergeant Kilborn's greeting offers the news (vNiptonVulpesvMojaveNCRTrooperTopic003, at 10: end script completes objective 10 and sets 100, whose script completes and stops the quest). Stage 15 is set by nothing in FalloutNV.esm. Stand-ins: travel by move_player; the walk into the trigger by trigger_enter.
Stand-in for the road south to the Mojave Outpost.
Stage 100 stops the quest, whose topics were all Kilborn offered: the conversation ends by itself.
